requirements.description: Establish exact endpoint roles/capabilities, negotiated signalling modes, firmware/clock requirements, VBUS detect/power behaviour in every required supply state and applicability of the specification/ECNs. A USB 2.0 label does not establish 480 Mbit/s operation.

Review the complete endpoint-to-endpoint channel, physical pad assignments, inline filters/ESD/connectors, layer changes, plane openings, actual return transfer, stubs and all source-backed layout requirements. Nearby GND via distance alone does not prove a valid return path.

Qualify actual channel cross-sections and discontinuities using selected fabrication data, mask/adjacent copper, launches, pads, vias and component models. Record pinned models/settings, convergence and bounds; nominal width/gap or uniform-line formulas do not replace this review.

Assess mode-applicable waveforms, timing/skew, loading and margins for the entire channel and actual transceivers/inline components. Use applicable test loads/planes and endpoints; do not substitute a high-speed template for full-speed operation or copper length for delay.

Measure mode-applicable electrical behaviour and verify enumeration/data transfer, firmware and attach/power transitions in the intended configurations. Retain candidate-bound reviewed test conditions/results; this contract is not USB-IF certification.
